# DataMySite

> > DataMySite is a Dubai-based advertising agency specializing in outdoor, transit, digital, and influencer marketing across the UAE and GCC region.

Led by industry experts including Seema Adnani, Osama Usmani, and Shveta Virmani, DataMySite delivers comprehensive advertising solutions from DOOH billboards on Sheikh Zayed Road to transit media campaigns across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and beyond. The agency serves major brands including Jetour, AYS Developers, Tranquil Developers, and ILG Luxury Group with data-driven marketing strategies.

## Key Topics

- Dubai outdoor advertising
- Transit media (bus, taxi, metro)
- DOOH (Digital Out-of-Home)
- Billboard advertising on Sheikh Zayed Road
- Brand awareness campaigns
- Influencer marketing (micro, macro, nano)
- UAE and GCC marketing
- Brand visibility strategies
- Business Bay and Dubai Marina locations
- Radio advertising (English stations)
- Event marketing and activations
- PR for luxury and lifestyle sectors
- SEO for Dubai businesses
- Corporate sponsorships
- Creative advertising innovation
